settings.title: Shell Recharge Account
settings.subtitle:
This page shows the current account credentials
The account can only be updated from the add new charge point wizard (add device) or the device repair function.

auth.intro: Sign in to 50five. If requested, enter the code sent to your email. Credentials and the verified session are stored encrypted on Homey.
auth.code_help: Enter the six-digit email code. The code is valid for 10 minutes. To request another code, return to login.
auth.repair_notice: 50five needs you to sign in again. Open your charge point’s Repair screen to enter the email code.
auth.busy: Please wait for the current login request.
auth.restart: Return to login to request a new verification code.
